title: Help me create a police action game in RPG maker

posts.author: Padrenho
posts.body: I wanted to know how to create a police action game based on 80s films, like Beverly Hills Cop, and I wanted to change a lot of things in RPG Maker for this game to work, I saw that there was a way transform games into 2D games so there must be a way to create an action game without having too much of an RPG, taking away many things like the life system and increasing life like an RPG and combat I don't want turn-based combat, but rather shoot enemies that appear at certain moments in the game, I also wanted to know some way to implement investigation in the game to continue the story , I will also want to implement an open map in the game with several locations to go with secondary missions, I want a really cool 80s style police action game, if you can help I would appreciate it

posts.author: TRIDIUM
posts.body:
Okay, I assume you're using VXAce.
You'll need a solid grasp of the engine's basics and eventing, as well as some sort of script/event system to replicate shooting mechanics. I would suggest using another engine, but if you really want to do it, this might be a good start.
Resident Evil VX Ace 3.0

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Familiarize yourself with the engine you're using. If you need help implementing a specific thing into your game, you can make a thread.
"I wantz cool police shooter game, plz halp!" isn't really going to do anything aside from getting people to tell you to learn how to use the engine.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
My suggestion is to learn the engine with a more regular RPG-Project before you try to tackle changing the engine that much.
yes, you can change a lot in the RPG-Makers - but the farther away you go from default JRPG, the more work and the more experience in bughunting you'll need.
And sorry, but your post sounds like a completely new developer without experience.
so you need to get that experience before trying to tackle such a thing.

posts.author: ShardsUnremebered40
posts.body:
I got a secret I stole from the RPG Maker 2000 era:
you can use common events to call upon the main game data
(such as GUI menus and ABS battle system)
with other events on the map to be event scripted enemies.
then you'll have the down to basics core of your shooter action game.
you're welcome (that's if you're quick on your feet.)
no hand-scripting required [unless you want to make it super awesome.]
(just smart enough to use variable on pictures, animations, player, events, e.t.c.)
Yes, it is THAT simple by FORMULA (but not super easy to implement.)
I said this as ENCOURAGEMENT for the short-cut do it yourselfers today.

posts.author: Padrenho
posts.body:
MysteryChaosKing9 said:
Eu tenho um segredo que roubei da era RPG Maker 2000:
você pode usar eventos comuns para acessar os dados principais do jogo
(como menus GUI e sistema de batalha ABS)
com outros eventos no mapa como inimigos programados para eventos.
então você terá o básico do seu jogo de ação de tiro.
de nada (isso se você for rápido).
não é necessário escrever à mão [a menos que você queira torná-lo super incrível.]
(inteligente o suficiente para usar variáveis em imagens, animações, player, eventos, etc.)
Sim, é TÃO simples pela FÓRMULA (mas não é muito fácil de implementar).
Eu disse isso como ENCORAJAMENTO para o atalho faça você mesmo hoje.
